notes: 5mm means nominal panel thickness, not layer height or infill width.
STL is unitless; the supplied reference is interpreted as millimetres.
The reference lid-edge STL is inspected as a geometric idea; it is not uniformly scaled.
Metal variant and its full-set handoff are unchanged.
Printed edge guards and fastening ears are omitted: the 5mm panels themselves have softened outer edges.
Lid and body remain joined only by removable transport straps. L brackets and M5 fasteners are metal, not printed substitutes.
Single-nozzle build-area checks use a rectangular envelope plus 5mm brim, not a completed Bambu Studio slice.
Lid interior rise is 38mm (2mm more than the supplied reference profile) to clear modeled M5 roof-fastener tips above the 27mm knob-height assumption.
P2 removes both floor and roof seam joining strips, their fasteners, washers and holes.
Floor halves have equal size, split at Y=0 with the retained 0.3mm assembly gap.
Each long-side lower central bracket is replaced by two independent brackets at Y=-25/+25mm. The rail-mount hole near Y=0 is preserved.
Floor and roof halves are supported independently at the perimeter. No direct seam connector, glue or new interlock is added.
